teaser: Three boarding calls go out before you even check the gate number again, because the ticket already told you where to stand. That is life path 4 meeting an ISTJ: a number built on steady, visible structure landing inside a type that already keeps its own house in order. The pairing is not two forces working toward the same thing from different directions — it is one habit, doubled. What is particular here is how little daylight shows between the number's demand for order and the letters' native comfort with it. The friction, when it comes, is quieter than most, and easy to miss until it is not.
